question: Can a fixed high-acceleration screen preserve the one-parameter cluster lens result while keeping the same locked law inside Mercury's published supplementary-precession margin?

selection_design.within_family_holdout: lexicographically last image in every source family with at least three images
selection_design.selection_metric: minimum equal-system exact held-out radial RMS across development clusters, requiring all held-out roots
selection_design.refinement: nine fixed linear points between the coarse winner's adjacent grid values; development images only
selection_design.disclosure: The clusters and their earlier scores have already been viewed. This is a deterministic replay holdout, not untouched external validation.

solar_source_convention.primary: isolated point-mass Sun with gbar(r)=GM_sun/r^2 and gbar(rstar)=GM_sun/rstar^2
solar_source_convention.scope: first-order secular osculating-orbit diagnostic; standard GR precession is the baseline and the reported value is the additional precession
solar_source_convention.limitation: This source-local convention is not yet a covariant multi-source field equation and does not perform a raw planetary-ephemeris refit.

Mercury_supplementary_precession_mas_per.source: Fienga et al. 2016, INPOP15a conservative criterion 1, https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00947

Cassini_gamma_minus_one.limitation: Cassini measured metric light-time parameter gamma, not a radial force fraction; zero slip is imposed here rather than derived.
